description: 静岡市道路休憩施設(推奨データセット) [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 静岡市. 静岡市が指定する道路休憩施設の位置情報です。 24時間対応のトイレが設置されています。. Coverage: 静岡市. The portal files it under the publisher 静岡市. Its tags are 静岡市道路休憩施設-推奨データセット. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-08-21 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
